Claims
1.
A valve block (1) with a line system for use in respect
of a tool attachment of a working machine, where
the tool attachment is adapted for connection to dif-
ferent kinds of hydraulically operated tools or imple-
ments with the aid of a hydraulically actuated locking
device (7) that the valve block (1) includes first port
means (17, 18) for connection to hydraulic lines (32,
33) of the working machine, second port means (19,
20) for connection to hydraulic coupling means (10)
adapted for coupling to hydraulic coupling elements
(12) of the tool or implement, and third port means
(21, 22) for connection to the locking device (7), that
a valve means (2) is provided in the valve block (1)
with a function which enables said first port means
(17, 18) to be connected selectively to either said
second port means (19, 20) or to said third port
means (21, 22), that the line system includes at least
one connecting line (40, 41) which is provided with
a valve means in the form of a check valve (6) and
which connects said second port means (19, 20) and
said third port means (21, 22) so as to obtain a post-
tensioning of the locking device (7) when the first
port means (17, 18) are connected to said second
port means (19, 20) and for relieving load prior to
connecting and disconnecting the hydraulic connec-
tion (12) of the working tool; characterized in that
the line system in the valve block (1) communicate
with said port means and also include valve means
(4, 5), wherein said valve means (4, 5) are adapted
to fulfil at least one of the following functions:
- a first function for ensuring the presence of
hydraulic pressure in the locking device (7) in
the event of a fracture or a leakage in the hy-
draulic lines (32, 33) of the working machine by
a first check valve (4) which is intended to pro-
vide said first function; and
- a second function for achieving pressure limi-
tation of the locking device (7) in that the third
port means (21, 22) include two ports (21, 22)
which are each connected to a hydraulic line (38,
39), and in that between which hydraulic lines
there is provided a connecting line (42) which
includes a pressure limiting valve (5) and which
is adapted to provide said second function.
2.
A valve block (1) according to claim 1, characterized
in that said valve means (4, 5) are adapted to fulfil
all of said functions.
3.
A valve block (1) according to any one of claim 1 -
2, characterized in that the valve block (1) includes
means (23) for fastening the valve block (1) to the
locking device (7).
4.
A valve block according to any one of claims 1 - 3,
characterized in that said valve means (2, 4, 5, 6)
include a reversing valve (2) which is adapted to pro-
vide said function which enables said first port means
(17, 18) to be connected selectively to either said
second port means (19, 20) or to said third port
means (21, 22).
5.
